title: THE STASH BELT KEYS ARE SQUARE AGAIN
why: Found by the full test run of 2026-10-11. Since the four gun keys (v22.45) the stash screen shows the gun picture on belt keys 1 to 4, and in a narrow stash window the picture box made every key taller than wide, 35 by 42, which breaks the square keys of v18.98 (seen on his 4K stash picture). The keys hide what spills over now, so they stay square at every width. Nothing else on the stash screen moves.
now: The tactical belt keys on the stash screen are square again.

edits.replacement:
#hub #hotplanwrap [data-plan]{ flex:1 1 0 !important; min-width:0 !important; max-width:76px; height:auto !important; aspect-ratio:1/1; overflow:hidden; min-height:0 !important; }
  /* v23.14: the four gun keys of v22.45 put a gun picture on keys 1 to 4 of this row, and its box set the height, so at a narrow width every key grew taller than wide (35 by 42). Hidden overflow lets the square win again (v18.98). */
